severely.usage: adv.严重地；严厉地，严肃地；索引p416

ex.en: Coastal towns were severely damaged by the typhoon, and thousands of residents remain without electricity.
ex.zh: 沿海城镇在台风中受损严重，数千居民仍然断电。

severity.usage: n.严重，严重性；严肃，严厉 Teaching 要走出mere 去convey 知识的circuit，而是要onbehalfof 知识去启迪思想。所以需要新的 strategy，需要动用脑cell，需要amuse 受众，需要abandon ；索引p416

ex.en: severity of data leakage
ex.zh: 数据泄露的严重性

sew.usage: 助记:sow(播种)的人把saw(锯开)的东西再sew(缝合)上；索引p416

ex.en: My grandmother taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
ex.zh: 祖母教我如何把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

ex.en: She sewed the torn curtain by hand before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来之前，她用手把撕破的窗帘缝好了。

ex.en: Many families used to sew their own clothes rather than buy them.
ex.zh: 过去许多家庭自己缝衣服而不是买衣服。

senses: n. [C] 男性；女性；雄性；雌性

ex.en: The application form asks candidates to indicate their sex, age and nationality, though all three are optional.
ex.zh: 申请表要求应试者注明性别、年龄和国籍，不过这三项均可不填。

senses: a. 性行为的；性别的；生殖的
adj. 性行为的,性的;性别的;生殖的;有性繁殖的

ex.en: Biologists explain how sexual reproduction increases genetic variation within a population.
ex.zh: 生物学家解释有性生殖如何增加种群内的遗传变异。

senses: adj. 破旧的，破烂的；不公正的
adj. 低劣的,卑鄙的,下流的
adj. 破旧的,衣衫褴褛的
shabby.usage: 同义shoddy,scruffy;派生shabbiness n.破旧,衣衫褴褛;卑鄙,下流

ex.en: Inspectors described the hospital's waiting rooms as shabby, with broken chairs and peeling paint throughout.
ex.zh: 检查人员形容医院候诊室破旧不堪，处处是破损的座椅和剥落的油漆。

ex.en: Volunteers planted trees along the playground to provide shade during the hot summer months.
ex.zh: 志愿者沿操场种下树木，以便在炎热的夏季提供荫凉。

senses: n. 虚幻的事物;形影不离的人(物)

ex.en: The towers cast a long shadow across the square as the street lamps flickered on one by one.
ex.zh: 高楼在广场上投下长长的影子，路灯一盏接一盏地闪烁着亮起。

senses: v. 亏待,欺骗(尤指骗钱)
shaft.usage: 助记:shaft(轴)是shift(转换)力量的装置吗?

ex.en: Engineers inspected the mine shaft carefully before allowing the workers to descend.
ex.zh: 工程师们在允许工人下井之前，仔细检查了矿井竖井。

shake.usage: 词组shake hands with sb.同……握手

ex.en: Experts warn that even a minor earthquake can shake buildings not designed to modern safety standards.
ex.zh: 专家警告，即使是轻微地震也可能使未按现代安全标准设计的建筑晃动。

senses: a. 颤抖的；不大出色的；成问题的；可能失败的
adj. 不可靠的；颤抖的；不稳固的

phrases.m: 一些明显不可靠的证据

ex.en: The peace agreement remains shaky, with both sides accusing the other of violating the ceasefire.
ex.zh: 和平协议依然不稳固，双方都指责对方违反停火协议。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: modal v. 将要，将会；应该

ex.en: The contract states that either party shall give thirty days' written notice before ending the agreement.
ex.zh: 合同规定，任何一方在终止协议前须提前三十天发出书面通知。

senses: adj. 浅的；浅薄的；肤浅的
shallow.usage: 浅滩（shallow）上可以挖到很多贝壳（shell）。

ex.en: These fish are found in shallow waters around the coast.
ex.zh: 这些鱼生长在海边浅水水域。

ex.en: He criticized the film for its shallow treatment of a serious social issue.
ex.zh: 他批评这部电影对严肃的社会问题处理肤浅。

ex.en: The river is shallow enough for children to play in during summer.
ex.zh: 这条河水很浅，夏天孩子们可以在里面玩耍。

senses: n. 耻辱,可耻的人(或事);憾事
shame.usage: 助记:出售sham(假冒)品牌shame(可耻);派生shameful adj.可耻的,不道德的

ex.en: But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
ex.zh: 但是,总体而言,其执行依赖于公开指责方式使人遵从。

senses: n. 洗发膏,香波;洗发,洗头

ex.en: The company recalled its best-selling shampoo after customers reported unexpected hair loss.
ex.zh: 在顾客反映出现异常脱发后，该公司召回了其最畅销的洗发水。

senses: n. 形状,外形;体形,身段

ex.en: The report examines how family background continues to shape students' career choices.
ex.zh: 报告考察了家庭背景如何持续影响学生的职业选择。

senses: vt.&vi. 共有；共享；有同样的感情（或想法、经历等）
n. 一份,份额,一部分;股份

phrases.m: 由某人承担,归某人享有

share.usage: 串词记忆：分享(share)珍贵的(rare)物品；索引p416

ex.en: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
ex.zh: 换句话说，它们（一些国家）都认为，国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

ex.en: The two companies agreed to share the cost of the new laboratory.
ex.zh: 两家公司同意分担新实验室的费用。

ex.en: Her share of the profits amounted to nearly fifty thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 她分得的利润接近五万美元。

shareholder.usage: n.股东；组合词：share(股份)+holder(持有者)→股份持有者→股东；索引p416

ex.en: Shareholders voted overwhelmingly against the merger, arguing that the price undervalued the company.
ex.zh: 股东们以压倒性多数反对合并，认为收购价低估了公司价值。

ex.en: Sharks are among the ocean's most efficient predators.
ex.zh: 鲨鱼是海洋中最高效的掠食动物之一。

ex.en: The tourist industry on the island depends heavily on shark diving.
ex.zh: 该岛的旅游业在很大程度上依赖鲨鱼潜水项目。

ex.en: Many shark species are now threatened by overfishing.
ex.zh: 目前许多鲨鱼物种因过度捕捞而受到威胁。

senses: adj. 锋利的,锐利的;刺耳的,敏锐的
adj. 轮廓分明的,鲜明的;急转的,突然的
adj. 锋利的；清晰的；急剧的；敏锐的
sharp.usage: 鲨鱼（shark）的牙齿是锋利的（sharp）；真 a sharp rise 急剧的增长；sharp criticism 严厉的批评；It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalization... 钝化全球化最锋利的棱角(2011)；

ex.en: Be careful—it has a sharp edge.
ex.zh: 小心点——它的边缘很锋利。

ex.en: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.
ex.zh: 全球和英国经济增长预期将会遭遇重挫，这会使我们提升幸福感和推动发展所依赖的日常服务逐渐式微。

ex.en: There has been a sharp fall in the number of students applying for humanities courses this year.
ex.zh: 今年申请人文类课程的学生数量急剧下降。

senses: vt.&vi. (使)提高，改善；(使)变得锋利，变得清晰
sharpen.usage: v.变锋利；提高；(使)加剧；索引p416

ex.en: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation for his or her career.
ex.zh: 通过理解并思考法律来强化判断力是一名记者为其事业应做的一项知识准备。

ex.en: Regular debate helps students sharpen their critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加辩论有助于学生提高批判性思维能力。

ex.en: He sharpened the knife before carving the roast.
ex.zh: 他先把刀磨快，然后切烤肉。

senses: adv. 尖刻地；急剧地；敏锐地
adv. 急剧地；严厉地；明显地

ex.en: Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply.
ex.zh: 从2012年左右开始，签证申请急剧增加。

ex.en: The sharpness of the new camera allows photographers to capture every detail of distant birds.
ex.zh: 新相机的高清晰度使摄影师能够捕捉远处鸟类的每一个细节。

shatter.usage: 近义：smash vt. 打碎；助记:shutter(百叶窗)被shatter(弄坏)了;派生shattering adj.令人震惊的；索引p416

ex.en: The explosion shattered every window in the street.
ex.zh: 爆炸震碎了街上所有的窗户。

ex.en: The defeat shattered the team's hopes of reaching the final.
ex.zh: 这场失利粉碎了该队进入决赛的希望。

ex.en: Her sudden resignation shattered the belief that the project was running smoothly.
ex.zh: 她的突然辞职打破了项目进展顺利的信念。

ex.en: He cut himself while trying to shave in a hurry before the early morning interview.
ex.zh: 清晨面试前，他匆忙刮胡子时划伤了自己。

ex.en: In her autobiography, she describes how she balanced research work with raising three children alone.
ex.zh: 在自传中，她讲述了自己如何一边独自抚养三个孩子，一边兼顾研究工作。

shear.usage: 助记:我的ear(耳朵)hear(听见)shear(修剪)树枝的声音

ex.en: Farmers shear the sheep once a year, in late spring, when the weather turns warm.
ex.zh: 农民每年在暮春天气转暖时给羊剪一次毛。

shed.usage: 同义cast,spread,throw off；v.去除，摆脱；(植物)落(叶)，(动 物)蜕(皮) n.棚屋，小屋

ex.en: The garden tools are kept in a wooden shed behind the house.
ex.zh: 园艺工具放在屋后的一间木棚里。

ex.en: The report sheds new light on the causes of the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 该报告为探究金融危机的成因提供了新的视角。

ex.en: Many trees shed their leaves in autumn.
ex.zh: 许多树木在秋天落叶。

ex.en: Farmers in the region still move their sheep to higher pastures at the beginning of every summer.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民至今仍在每年夏初把羊群赶往更高的牧场。

ex.en: A well-trained sheepdog can control a flock of two hundred sheep with only a few whistles from its owner.
ex.zh: 一条训练有素的牧羊犬仅凭主人的几声口哨就能控制两百只羊。

senses: adj. [用来强调事物的大小、程度或数量]极其…的；完全的

ex.en: the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways
ex.zh: 维持旧世界(生活)方式的极大困难

ex.en: Each candidate was given a clean sheet of paper on which to write the final answer.
ex.zh: 每位考生都得到一张干净的纸，用来写下最终答案。

ex.en: Supermarkets place products at eye level on the shelf because shoppers are more likely to notice them there.
ex.zh: 超市把商品摆在货架与视线齐平的位置，因为顾客在那里更容易注意到它们。

ex.en: The beach was covered with shells of every shape, which the children collected eagerly.
ex.zh: 海滩上满是各种形状的贝壳，孩子们兴致勃勃地拾捡。

ex.en: Doctors advised him to avoid shellfish because they could trigger a severe allergic reaction.
ex.zh: 医生建议他避免食用贝类，因为那可能引发严重的过敏反应。

senses: v. 掩蔽,庇护,提供避难所;躲避,避难

phrases.p: the basic drives for food or shelter
phrases.m: 对食物或住所的基本需求

shelter.usage: 发音类似“歇（休息）了他”→为了救助难民，他实在太累了，在“避难所”休息一下。；串词记忆：小小的架子(shelf)不能帮我遮蔽(shelter)风雨；索引p416

ex.en: They were anxious to find shelter for the night.
ex.zh: 他们急于找个地方过夜。

ex.en: The charity provides food and shelter for homeless families during the coldest months.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构在最寒冷的月份为无家可归的家庭提供食物和住所。

ex.en: The thick forest sheltered the animals from hunters and gave them a safe place to breed.
ex.zh: 茂密的森林使动物免遭猎人捕杀，并为它们提供了安全的繁殖场所。

ex.en: The shepherd led the flock across the narrow bridge moments before the flood reached the valley.
ex.zh: 牧羊人赶着羊群通过狭窄的桥，片刻之后洪水便抵达了山谷。

senses: v. 保护,保卫;庇护,掩盖
shield.usage: 近义：safeguard vt. 保护；[近]protect vt. 保护；同义:safeguard,protect;shelter；n.盾(牌)；防护物 v.保护

ex.en: The ozone layer shields the earth from the sun's harmful rays.
ex.zh: 臭氧层保护地球免受太阳有害射线的伤害。

ex.en: The metal shield protected the workers from flying sparks.
ex.zh: 金属防护屏保护工人免受飞溅火花的伤害。

ex.en: Critics argue that the new law shields careless companies from responsibility.
ex.zh: 批评者认为新法律使粗心的公司得以逃避责任。

senses: n. 轮班；轮班工作时间
shift.usage: switch 的近义词；shift off 推卸,逃避;同义:change,substitute；v.转移，改变；索引p416

ex.en: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
ex.zh: 大部分资金将来自每封信一美分的永久性费率增加以及将邮政退休人员转入美国国家医疗保险制度。

ex.en: Over the last ten years there has been a fundamental shift in the way we do business.
ex.zh: 在过去的十年里，我们做生意的方式发生了根本性的转变。

ex.en: One study found that people responded best to comments that shifted from negative to positive, possibly because it suggested they had won somebody over.
ex.zh: 一项研究发现，人们对从消极转为积极的评价反应最好，可能是因为这表明他们赢得了某人的支持。

ex.en: He bruised his shin against the low table but continued playing as if nothing had happened.
ex.zh: 他的小腿撞上了矮桌，淤青了一块，但他装作没事继续玩。

ex.en: The morning sun began to shine through the fog, revealing a harbour crowded with fishing boats.
ex.zh: 晨光开始穿透雾霭照耀下来，显露出挤满渔船的港口。

ex.en: The factory ships its furniture to customers across the country within ten working days.
ex.zh: 工厂在十个工作日内把家具运送给全国各地的客户。

ex.en: A shipload of grain arrived at the port this morning.
ex.zh: 今晨一船粮食抵达港口。

ex.en: The region once exported shipload after shipload of timber to Europe.
ex.zh: 该地区曾把一船又一船的木材运往欧洲。

ex.en: They ordered a whole shipload of machinery for the new factory.
ex.zh: 他们为新工厂订购了整整一船机械设备。

senses: n. 装船,装运,装载的货物,装载量(c/u)
shipment.usage: ship(船)+ment(名词后缀)→装运；n.运输，运送；运输的货 物

ex.en: A shipment of medical supplies was delayed at customs for nearly two weeks because of incomplete paperwork.
ex.zh: 由于单据不全，一批医疗物资在海关滞留了近两周。

ex.en: The shipper remains responsible for the goods until they are loaded onto the vessel at the port.
ex.zh: 在货物于港口装上船只之前，发货人对其负有责任。

ex.en: The players exchanged shirts after the match, a tradition that dates back more than half a century.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后球员们互相交换了球衣，这一传统可追溯到半个多世纪以前。

ex.en: A cold wind made the campers shiver, so they gathered closer around the fire.
ex.zh: 冷风让露营者们直打寒战，于是他们朝篝火凑得更近了。

shock.usage: 派生shocking adj.骇人的；令人激动的；极坏的；v.使震惊，使难以置信 n.令人震惊的事；吃惊，震惊

ex.en: The news of his death came as a great shock to everyone.
ex.zh: 他去世的消息让所有人都深感震惊。

ex.en: The survey results shocked the public and prompted calls for reform.
ex.zh: 调查结果令公众震惊，引发了改革呼声。

ex.en: She was treated for shock after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故发生后，她因休克接受了治疗。

ex.en: The demand for handmade leather shoes has risen sharply as more consumers begin to value quality over price.
ex.zh: 随着越来越多的消费者开始重视质量而非价格，手工皮鞋的需求急剧上升。

senses: v. (shot,shot) 射击,发射,开(枪),放(炮)
v. 突然迅速地移动；发芽
n. 狩猎,狩猎队,狩猎场；嫩枝,幼苗
shoot.usage: 词组shoot up迅速升起;快速成长;shoot down击落,射下;shoot off放(枪),开(炮)

ex.en: The director plans to shoot the final scene on location in the mountains next spring.
ex.zh: 导演计划明年春天在山区的实景地拍摄最后一幕。

ex.en: Small shops in the town center have struggled to survive since the giant supermarket opened nearby.
ex.zh: 自从大型超市在附近开业以来，镇中心的小商店一直在艰难求生。

ex.en: Online shopping has changed consumer habits so thoroughly that many stores in the high street have closed.
ex.zh: 网购彻底改变了消费习惯，以至于许多商业街的店铺已经关门。

ex.en: Waves carried plastic waste to the shore, reminding tourists of the urgent need to protect the marine environment.
ex.zh: 海浪把塑料垃圾冲上岸，提醒游客保护海洋环境刻不容缓。

senses: a. 短的；个子矮的；短暂的
adj. 短的,矮的;(of)缺乏,不足

ex.en: The company's supply of raw materials fell short of demand, forcing it to delay the launch of its new product.
ex.zh: 公司原材料供应供不应求，被迫推迟新产品上市。

ex.en: Critics say the government's short-term policies sacrifice long-term investment in education and infrastructure.
ex.zh: 批评者说，政府的短期政策牺牲了对教育和基础设施的长期投资。

senses: n. 短期效益主义;短期行为

ex.en: Shareholders blamed the company's decline on short-termism, which discouraged spending on research.
ex.zh: 股东们将公司的衰落归咎于短期效益主义，因为它打击了研发投入。

shortage.usage: short(短)+age(名词后缀)→缺少；n.短缺，不足；short（短的，引申为“短缺”）+age（名词后缀）→缺乏；索引p416

ex.en: There is no shortage of things to do in the town.
ex.zh: 城里不愁找不到活儿干。

ex.en: A global shortage of computer chips has forced car factories to slow production lines.
ex.zh: 全球电脑芯片短缺迫使汽车工厂放缓生产线。

ex.en: The hospital reports a serious shortage of trained nurses, especially in emergency departments.
ex.zh: 这家医院报告称训练有素的护士严重短缺，急诊部门尤为突出。

ex.en: There were obvious shortcomings in the report.
ex.zh: 这个报告有明显瑕疵。

ex.en: Despite its shortcomings, the study remains an important contribution to the field.
ex.zh: 尽管存在缺陷，这项研究仍是对该领域的重要贡献。

ex.en: The main shortcoming of the plan is that it ignores long-term costs.
ex.zh: 该计划的主要缺点是忽视了长期成本。

senses: n. 近路,捷径;快捷方式

ex.en: Experienced programmers know that there is no shortcut to writing reliable and secure code.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的程序员知道，编写可靠、安全的代码没有捷径可走。

ex.en: The new bridge will shorten the journey between the two cities by nearly two hours.
ex.zh: 新桥将使两座城市之间的行程缩短近两个小时。

ex.en: The charity faced a serious funding shortfall and had to cut several community programmes.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构面临严重的资金缺口，不得不削减几个社区项目。

senses: n. 速记(法)；(对某事)简略的表达方式
shorthand.usage: short(短)+hand(手)→短时间用手写→速记；索引p416

ex.en: Journalists once relied on shorthand to record interviews accurately, but digital recorders have largely replaced this skill.
ex.zh: 新闻记者过去依靠速记准确记录采访内容，但数码录音笔已在很大程度上取代了这项技能。

ex.en: Wear shorts and trainers for the fun run, and bring a bottle of water because the weather may be hot.
ex.zh: 参加趣味跑请穿短裤和运动鞋，并带一瓶水，因为天气可能很热。

ex.en: The vaccine requires a second shot within six months to ensure long-lasting protection against the virus.
ex.zh: 这种疫苗需要在六个月内注射第二针，以确保对病毒的长期保护。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: modal v. 应该，应当；本应；可能；万一

ex.en: Governments should invest more in public transport if they hope to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 如果政府希望缓解交通拥堵和空气污染，就应该加大对公共交通的投入。

senses: n. 肩膀；（衣服的）肩部；山肩；瓶肩
shoulder.usage: put one's shoulder to the wheel 全力以赴

ex.en: Senior managers must shoulder the responsibility for the company's failure to respond to the crisis in time.
ex.zh: 高层管理人员必须为公司未能及时应对危机承担责任。

senses: vt.&vi. 大声说；叫；嚷；斥责；怒骂

ex.en: The coach shouted instructions from the sidelines, but the noisy crowd made it hard for players to hear.
ex.zh: 教练在场边大声喊出指令，但喧闹的人群让队员们很难听清。

ex.en: Passengers began to shove their way onto the crowded train, ignoring the staff's repeated warnings.
ex.zh: 乘客们开始推挤着挤上拥挤的火车，无视工作人员的一再警告。

ex.en: Workers used a shovel to clear the snow from the platform before the morning trains arrived.
ex.zh: 工人们在早班列车到达之前用铁铲清除站台上的积雪。

senses: vt. 呈现,显示;表明,证明
vt. 表明；（图画、图表、文章等）表示；表现；显示出（品质、特征）；展示
show.usage: 辨析：show 最普通的用词，泛指任何有意或无意地把东西给别人看的行为；索引p416

ex.en: Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
ex.zh: 雇主既要说明原因，又要按公正的程序办事。

ex.en: The data show a clear link between sleep loss and poor memory.
ex.zh: 数据清楚地表明了睡眠不足与记忆力下降之间的联系。

ex.en: Thousands of visitors came to see the annual motor show.
ex.zh: 数千名参观者前来观看一年一度的车展。

senses: n. 阵雨,阵雨般的东西;一大批,一大串
n. 淋浴,淋浴器,淋浴间
v. 下降雨;阵雨般落下
shower.usage: be caught in a shower 遇到一阵大暴雨;a shower of 一大批

ex.en: The weather forecast warns that a heavy shower will sweep across the region tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 天气预报警告说，明天下午一场阵雨将席卷该地区。

senses: adj. 机灵的,敏锐的,精明的
adj. 精明的；敏锐的；有眼光的；判断得准的
shrewd.usage: 24 谐音记忆更牢固呦；发音类似"熟的"→熟悉这个事物的人，看待它一般比较"敏锐"→敏锐的；索引p416

ex.en: Paul was too shrewd to be taken in by this argument.
ex.zh: 保罗太精明了，不会被这场争论所欺骗。

ex.en: She made a shrewd investment in the property market years ago.
ex.zh: 多年前她在房地产市场做了一笔精明的投资。

ex.en: The shrewd negotiator refused to reveal his bottom price.
ex.zh: 这位精明的谈判者拒绝透露自己的底价。

ex.en: The coastal economy depends heavily on shrimp farming, which now employs thousands of local families.
ex.zh: 沿海经济严重依赖养虾业，该行业如今雇用了数千户当地家庭。

senses: v. (使)(数量、体积或价值)减少,缩小
v. (尤指因恐惧而)畏缩,退缩; n. 精神病学家
shrink.usage: v.缩小，减少；缩水；退缩，畏 缩 n.心理学家；shr(联想share分享)+ink(墨水)→分享墨水给别人

ex.en: The market for their products is shrinking.
ex.zh: 市场对他们产品的需求在减少。

ex.en: The wool sweater shrank badly after one wash.
ex.zh: 那件羊毛衫洗了一次就严重缩水。

ex.en: Europe's share of the global economy continues to shrink.
ex.zh: 欧洲在全球经济中的份额继续萎缩。

senses: n. 寿衣,裹尸布;覆盖物;遮蔽物

ex.en: Thick fog shrouded the valley all morning, making the rescue operation far more difficult.
ex.zh: 浓雾笼罩山谷一整个上午，使救援行动难上加难。

ex.en: The gardeners replaced the tired lawn with low shrubs that need far less water in summer.
ex.zh: 园林工人用低矮灌木取代了老化的草坪，这类灌木夏季需水少得多。

senses: v. 耸肩(表示不知道或不在乎)

ex.en: When asked about the company's future plans, the director simply shrugged and refused to give a direct answer.
ex.zh: 当被问及公司的未来规划时，董事只是耸了耸肩，拒绝给出直接回答。

senses: vt.&vi. 关上；关闭；合上；（使）停止营业
shut.usage: v.关闭，合上 adj.关闭的；停业的

ex.en: The factory was shut down after repeated safety violations.
ex.zh: 这家工厂因多次违反安全规定而被关闭。

ex.en: He shut the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
ex.zh: 他轻轻关上门，以免吵醒婴儿。

ex.en: Most shops shut by six o'clock in this small town.
ex.zh: 在这座小镇上，大多数商店六点前就关门了。

senses: n. 百叶窗,(照相机)快门

ex.en: She pressed the shutter at the exact moment the bird spread its wings.
ex.zh: 她在鸟儿展开翅膀的一瞬间按下了快门。

senses: n. 往返汽车(列车、飞机)

ex.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the airport and the city center every twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 一辆免费班车每二十分钟在机场和市中心之间往返一趟。

senses: a. 羞怯的；腼腆的；易受惊的

phrases.m: 不愿承担(某任务)或面对(某人)

ex.en: The shy student rarely spoke in class, yet his essays revealed remarkable depth of thought.
ex.zh: 这个害羞的学生很少在课堂上发言，但他的文章显示出深刻的思想。

ex.en: Research suggests that a child's language develops faster when he or she has an older sibling.
ex.zh: 研究表明，有哥哥或姐姐的孩子语言发展更快。

senses: adj. 生病的；恶心的；厌倦的

ex.en: Several passengers fell sick during the long flight, and the crew asked for medical assistance on landing.
ex.zh: 几名乘客在长途飞行中病倒，机组人员在落地后请求医疗救助。

ex.en: From the root sid or sess, meaning to sit, English derives such familiar words as president, residence and session.
ex.zh: 英语中 president、residence 和 session 等常见词都来自意为“坐”的词根 sid 或 sess。

ex.en: Although few readers notice it, the root sider, meaning star, hides inside familiar words such as desire and sidereal.
ex.zh: 尽管很少被读者注意，意为“星星”的词根 sider 其实藏在 desire 和 sidereal 等常见词之中。

ex.en: The ancient city withstood a siege of nearly two years before its walls finally fell.
ex.zh: 这座古城在近两年的围攻中坚守不降，城墙最终才被攻破。

ex.en: She poured the flour through a fine sieve to remove any small lumps.
ex.zh: 她把面粉倒进细筛子里，筛去小面疙瘩。

senses: vt. 筛(面粉或颗粒较细的物质)；挑选
v. 细查;详审;区分;挑选
v. 精选,筛(面粉或颗粒较细的物质)

ex.en: Researchers spent months sifting through thousands of documents in search of evidence to support their hypothesis.
ex.zh: 研究人员花了数月时间仔细筛查数千份文件，以寻找支持其假设的证据。

ex.en: The colonists' first glimpse of the new land was a sight of dense woods.
ex.zh: 殖民者们最先看到的新大陆景象是茂密的丛林。

ex.en: The Great Wall is one of the most famous sights in the world.
ex.zh: 长城是世界上最著名的名胜之一。

ex.en: The bridge disappeared from sight in the heavy fog.
ex.zh: 大雾中，那座桥从视野里消失了。

senses: adj. 看得见的;有视力的
adj. [-sighted (用以构成复合词)]有……视力的;视力……的

ex.en: The museum offers audio guides so that visually impaired visitors, as well as sighted ones, can enjoy the exhibition.
ex.zh: 博物馆提供语音导览，让视障游客和明眼游客都能欣赏展览。

ex.en: Most tourists spend their first day in the city sightseeing rather than visiting museums.
ex.zh: 大多数游客在该市的第一天是观光游览，而不是参观博物馆。

ex.en: In the high season the old town becomes so crowded that each sightseer struggles to photograph the famous clock tower.
ex.zh: 旺季时老城十分拥挤，每位观光客都很难拍到那座著名的钟楼。

sign.usage: 同义 indication；n.指示牌，标志；迹象，征兆； 手势 v.签名，署名；签约；打手势；n.指示牌，标志；迹象，征兆； 手势 v.签名；签约；索引p416

ex.en: There are clear signs that the economy is recovering.
ex.zh: 有明显的迹象表明经济正在复苏。

ex.en: He signed the contract in the presence of his lawyer.
ex.zh: 他在律师在场的情况下签署了合同。

ex.en: Follow the signs to reach the city centre.
ex.zh: 跟着路标走就能到市中心。

senses: v. 发信号，用信号通知
signal.usage: 辨析：sign 信号、记号、征兆，指有意或无意、自然或人工的；signal 指有意地、预定地发出的信号，引人注意；symbol 符号、象征，指用文字符号指代某事；n.信号；标志；信号灯 v.发信号，示意；标志；表示； 示意 adj.重大的，显要的；词根sign：to mark标记，to sign发信号；另义vt.表明：

ex.en: Eye contact can be a friendly social signal.
ex.zh: 眼神交流可以是一种友好的社交信号。

ex.en: She made a signal for the car to stop.
ex.zh: 她打了个手势，让汽车停下了。

ex.en: It sends a mixed message, and your counterpart gets to choose what signals to read.
ex.zh: 它（指肢体语言）释放出一个混合的信息，而你的聆听者就会选择去读取哪些信号。

signature.usage: n.签名，署名；签署；鲜明特 色

ex.en: The contract is not valid until it bears the manager's signature.
ex.zh: 合同要有经理的签字才能生效。

ex.en: He forged his boss's signature to get access to the funds.
ex.zh: 他伪造了老板的签名以获取资金。

ex.en: The bank requires the customer's signature on every withdrawal form.
ex.zh: 银行要求顾客在每张取款单上签名。

significance.usage: sign(记号)+ific(做)+ance→做出标记→意义；[族] significant；n.重要性，意义；意思，含义

ex.en: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
ex.zh: 其次，大多数使用联网计算机进行上传的人，甚至不会意识到他们所做事情的重要性。

ex.en: The discovery has great significance for the treatment of cancer.
ex.zh: 这一发现对癌症的治疗具有重大意义。

ex.en: Few people understood the significance of the minister's resignation at the time.
ex.zh: 当时几乎没有人理解部长辞职的深远意义。

senses: a. 重要的；意义重大的
adj. 有重大意义的，显著的
significant.usage: adj.相当数量的；重要的；意 味深长的；sign（标记）+ific+ant（形容词后缀）→在重要地方做标记；索引p416

ex.en: There is a significant increase of opportunities.
ex.zh: 机会显著增加。

ex.en: The building has housed some of the nation's most significant diplomats and politicians and has been the scene of many historic events.
ex.zh: 一些美国最重要的外交官和政治家曾在这座大楼里工作。它也曾是许多历史事件发生的地点。

ex.en: The study found no significant difference in exam results between the two teaching methods.
ex.zh: 研究发现，两种教学方法在考试成绩上没有显著差异。

significantly.usage: adv.显著地，相当数量地；值 得注意的是

ex.en: The new teaching method significantly improved students' reading scores within a single term.
ex.zh: 新的教学方法在单个学期内显著提高了学生的阅读成绩。

senses: v. 表示，说明；表达，显示
signify.usage: sign（标记，标志）+ify（使……化）→用标记来表示或说明；索引p416

ex.en: The white belt signifies that he's an absolute beginner.
ex.zh: 白腰带表示他完全是个新手。

ex.en: In China, the colour red often signifies good fortune.
ex.zh: 在中国，红色通常象征着好运。

ex.en: The president's absence signified his disapproval of the plan.
ex.zh: 总统的缺席表明他不同意该计划。

silence.usage: 词组keep silence保持沉默;派生silencer n.消音器

ex.en: After the announcement, a heavy silence fell over the meeting room, as nobody expected such a decision.
ex.zh: 宣布之后，会议室陷入一片沉重的寂静，因为没有人预料到这样的决定。

ex.en: The courtroom fell silent as the judge began to read the verdict.
ex.zh: 法官开始宣读判决时，法庭上一片寂静。

ex.en: The region's economy shifted from agriculture to silicon-based industries within a single generation.
ex.zh: 该地区经济在一代人之内就从农业转型为以硅为基础的产业。

ex.en: Centuries ago, Chinese silk was transported along the ancient trade routes and prized by European nobles.
ex.zh: 几个世纪前，中国丝绸沿着古代商路运输，深受欧洲贵族珍视。

ex.en: The teacher's patience allowed the students to laugh at their own silliness and start the task again.
ex.zh: 老师的宽容让学生们能够笑对自己的愚蠢举动，重新开始任务。

senses: adj. 傻的,愚蠢的,糊涂的

ex.en: It would be silly to abandon the project now, after so much time and money have been invested.
ex.zh: 在投入了这么多时间和金钱之后放弃该项目，将是愚蠢的。

ex.en: The harbour has to be dredged regularly because silt from the river blocks the entrance.
ex.zh: 港口必须定期疏浚，因为河流带来的泥沙堵塞了入口。

ex.en: The museum houses a fine collection of silver coins dating back to the Roman Empire.
ex.zh: 博物馆收藏了一批精美的可追溯到罗马帝国时期的银币。

senses: a. 类似的；相像的；相仿的
similar.usage: 派生 similarity n. 类似，相似，类似点；adj.相像的，类似的；索引p416

ex.en: The two companies offer strikingly similar services at very different prices.
ex.zh: 这两家公司提供的服务惊人地相似，价格却相差很大。

ex.en: Her style is similar to that of the early impressionists.
ex.zh: 她的风格与早期印象派画家相似。

ex.en: Students from similar backgrounds tend to choose similar careers.
ex.zh: 背景相似的学生往往选择相似的职业。

ex.en: The study found a striking similarity between the two cultures' funeral customs despite their geographical distance.
ex.zh: 研究发现，尽管相距遥远，这两种文化的丧葬习俗却有着惊人的相似之处。

ex.en: The northern cities grew rapidly during the industrial age; similarly, the ports of the south expanded as trade increased.
ex.zh: 北部城市在工业时代迅速发展；同样，随着贸易增长，南部港口也不断扩张。

senses: vi. 充满(难以控制的感情，尤指愤怒)；即将爆发，酝酿
v. 炖,煨;即将爆发;酝酿

ex.en: Tensions between the two departments had been simmering for months before they finally erupted into an open quarrel.
ex.zh: 两个部门之间的紧张关系酝酿了数月，最终爆发为公开争吵。

ex.en: The professor explained the complex theory in simple language so that even beginners could follow it.
ex.zh: 教授用简单的语言解释了这一复杂理论，连初学者都能听懂。

ex.en: The appeal of the design lies in its simplicity, which makes the product easy to manufacture and use.
ex.zh: 该设计的魅力在于其简洁，这使得产品易于制造和使用。

ex.en: The simplification of the tax code won broad public support.
ex.zh: 税法的简化赢得了广泛的社会支持。

ex.en: His explanation is a simplification, but it captures the basic idea.
ex.zh: 他的解释是一种简化，但抓住了基本要点。

ex.en: The software update brought a welcome simplification of the settings menu.
ex.zh: 软件更新带来了设置菜单的可喜简化。

simplify.usage: simple的意思是“简单的，单纯的”，那动词simplify就是“使简单化”。；索引p416

ex.en: The company simplified its product range to cut costs.
ex.zh: 为削减成本，公司简化了产品种类。

ex.en: The new rules aim to simplify the visa application process.
ex.zh: 新规定旨在简化签证申请流程。

ex.en: Try to simplify your explanation for younger readers.
ex.zh: 尽量把你的解释简化，以便年轻读者理解。

ex.en: The committee rejected the plan not because it was risky but because it was simply too expensive.
ex.zh: 委员会否决该计划，不是因为它有风险，而仅仅是因为成本太高。

simulate.usage: simul（相同）+ate→做成相同→模拟。近义：imitate vt. 模仿；simul（表示“相似”）+ate（动词后缀）→“使……相似”→模仿。；索引p416

ex.en: Algorithms that are used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns.
ex.zh: 用于模拟人际互动的算法正在引发诸多此类的担忧。

ex.en: The software simulates real flying conditions for trainee pilots.
ex.zh: 该软件为受训飞行员模拟真实的飞行条件。

ex.en: She simulated surprise, though she had read the email in advance.
ex.zh: 她装出惊讶的样子，尽管她事先已看过那封邮件。

ex.en: Flight simulation allows pilots to practice handling emergencies without any risk to passengers or aircraft.
ex.zh: 飞行模拟使飞行员能够在不危及乘客和飞机的情况下练习处理紧急情况。

senses: a. 同时发生的；同时的
adj. 同时的,同时发生的
adj. 同时的，同时发生的
simultaneous.usage: simult（相同时间）+aneous→同时的。副词 simultaneously 同时地

ex.en: They will provide simultaneous translation of the President's speech into English.
ex.zh: 他们将为总统的讲话提供英语同声传译。

ex.en: The negotiations triggered simultaneous protests in several major cities.
ex.zh: 谈判在几个大城市同时引发了抗议。

ex.en: The policy prompted simultaneous reforms in education and healthcare.
ex.zh: 这项政策推动了教育和医疗领域的同步改革。

ex.en: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more subdisciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
ex.zh: 随着科学技术的进步，且分化出更多的分支学科，该中心同时期待着这样一个时代，即一流的研究者也可能成为艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。

ex.en: In many traditional cultures, wasting food is regarded as a sin against both family and society.
ex.zh: 在许多传统文化中，浪费食物被视为对家庭和社会的罪过。

ex.en: Since e-payment became widespread, many consumers rarely carry cash with them when shopping.
ex.zh: 自从电子支付普及以来，许多消费者购物时很少携带现金。

senses: adj. 诚挚的,真实的,诚恳的

ex.en: Please accept our sincere thanks.
ex.zh: 请接受我们诚挚的谢意。

ex.en: She offered a sincere apology for the delay in replying.
ex.zh: 她为延迟回复诚恳地道歉。

ex.en: He has a sincere interest in improving public education.
ex.zh: 他真诚地关注改善公共教育。

ex.en: We sincerely hope that both sides will return to the negotiating table as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 我们真诚希望双方能尽快回到谈判桌前。

ex.en: Birds sing more frequently at dawn, a phenomenon scientists attribute to the quietness of the early hours.
ex.zh: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱得更频繁，科学家将这一现象归因于清晨的宁静。

ex.en: Singapore has become a global financial centre largely because of its stable government and open trade policies.
ex.zh: 新加坡之所以成为全球金融中心，很大程度上归功于其稳定的政府和开放的贸易政策。

single.usage: 辨析:single强调只有一个,可指单人/未婚/独身;separate强调与其他事物分离;particular指固定事物中某事物的独特性；adj.单个的；单人的 n.单程票；单人房间 v.单独挑出；① adj.（特指某人或事物）② adj. 单身的；索引p416

ex.en: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
ex.zh: 感觉不幸福的父母很少会反思自己是否不该养孩子，而那些不幸福的没有孩子的人却困扰于"孩子是世上唯一最重要的"这种言论：显然他们的不幸福肯定是此生没有生孩子所直接造成的。

ex.en: Not a single student failed the final examination.
ex.zh: 期末考试没有一名学生不及格。

ex.en: She remained single until she was forty.
ex.zh: 她直到四十岁一直单身。

senses: adj. 显著的；【语法】单数的

ex.en: Her singular talent for turning abstract ideas into vivid stories made her novels popular worldwide.
ex.zh: 她将抽象思想化为生动故事的非凡才华使她的小说风靡全球。

senses: adj. 危险的;不祥的;凶兆的;险恶的

ex.en: The novel opens in a sinister old house where every sound seems to warn of danger.
ex.zh: 小说在一座阴森的老宅中开篇，那里的每个声音似乎都在预示危险。

ex.en: Without immediate repairs, the old ship would sink before reaching the nearest port.
ex.zh: 如果不立即修理，这艘旧船就会在抵达最近港口之前沉没。

senses: v. 小口地喝,呷茶,啜饮

ex.en: He took a slow sip of coffee and returned to the report he had been reading all morning.
ex.zh: 他慢慢啜了一口咖啡，然后继续阅读他一上午都在看的报告。

senses: n. （对不认识的男性的尊称）先生

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the nearest subway station is?
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我最近的地铁站在哪里吗？

ex.en: Residents rushed into the streets when the air-raid siren sounded shortly after midnight.
ex.zh: 午夜刚过防空警报响起时，居民们纷纷冲上街头。

ex.en: The root sist, meaning to stand, appears in a wide range of words, including insist, resist and consist.
ex.zh: 意为“站立”的词根 sist 出现在 insist、resist 和 consist 等众多词汇中。

ex.en: My elder sister works as a volunteer teacher in a remote village every summer vacation.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每年暑假都在一个偏远村庄做志愿教师。

ex.en: The ancient temple sits on a hillside overlooking the entire valley, attracting visitors all year round.
ex.zh: 这座古庙坐落在可以俯瞰整个山谷的山坡上，全年吸引着游客。

senses: n. 场所；发生地；（事件发生的）现场；网站

ex.en: Until recently, Internet marketing activities have focused on strategies to "pull" customers into sites.
ex.zh: 就在不久前，互联网上的营销活动还集中在如何将用户"拉进"网站的策略问题上。

ex.en: The construction site will be closed during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期期间建筑工地将关闭。

ex.en: The new factory is sited near a major highway.
ex.zh: 新工厂坐落在一条主要公路附近。

ex.en: The new research center is situated on the edge of the campus to encourage cooperation with local firms.
ex.zh: 新研究中心位于校园边缘，以便促进与当地企业的合作。

phrases.p: in face of the present situation

ex.en: The economic situation has improved slightly over the past six months.
ex.zh: 过去六个月，经济形势略有好转。

ex.en: In such a situation, most consumers choose the cheaper brand.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，大多数消费者会选择更便宜的品牌。

ex.en: The government is closely monitoring the situation along the border.
ex.zh: 政府正在密切注视边境地区的局势。

ex.en: The committee will review six proposals next week and select two of them for further study.
ex.zh: 委员会下周将评审六份提案，并选出其中两份作进一步研究。

ex.en: The size of the crowd surprised the police, who had expected only a few thousand protesters.
ex.zh: 人群的规模令警方吃惊，他们原以为只有几千名抗议者。

ex.en: In winter, the frozen lake becomes a natural rink where children skate under their parents' watchful eyes.
ex.zh: 冬天，结冰的湖面成了天然溜冰场，孩子们在父母的看护下滑冰。

ex.en: The frozen lake attracts hundreds of families for skating every winter.
ex.zh: 每年冬天，结冰的湖面都吸引数以百计的家庭前来滑冰。

ex.en: Scientists discovered a dinosaur skeleton so complete that they could reconstruct how the animal moved.
ex.zh: 科学家发现了一具非常完整的恐龙骨架，据此可以复原这种动物的运动方式。

senses: adj. 怀疑的，持怀疑态度的
skeptical.usage: 亦作 sceptical；[族] skepticism n. 怀疑论；skep（察看）+ti+cal（后缀）→要察看→不放心，持怀疑态度。；书中亦作sceptical;词根:skep(examine调查)+tic(silent沉默)+al(形容词后缀)→默默调查的→怀疑的;易混词辨析:skeptical和suspici

ex.en: Art became more skeptical of happiness.
ex.zh: 艺术对快乐愈发怀疑。

ex.en: You could argue that art became more skeptical of happiness because modern times have seen so much misery.
ex.zh: 你可能会争辩说，艺术对快乐越来越质疑是因为现代社会见证了如此多的苦难。

ex.en: Investors remain skeptical about the company's promise of quick profits.
ex.zh: 投资者对该公司快速盈利的承诺仍持怀疑态度。

ex.en: Experts remain skeptical about claims that the new battery can be fully charged in five minutes.
ex.zh: 专家们对“新电池五分钟即可充满”的说法仍持怀疑态度。

senses: n. 怀疑主义；怀疑态度

ex.en: The public's growing skepticism about advertising has forced companies to seek more credible endorsements.
ex.zh: 公众对广告日益增长的怀疑态度迫使企业寻求更可信的代言。

ex.en: Scientific progress depends on a healthy skepticism towards every new claim, however impressive it may sound.
ex.zh: 科学进步有赖于对每一个新论断——无论听起来多么惊人——保持健康的怀疑态度。

senses: n. 幽默短剧；简述；素描；略图

ex.en: The architect sketched the building's outline on the back of an envelope.
ex.zh: 建筑师在信封背面勾画了建筑的轮廓。

ex.en: She made a quick sketch of the harbor before the light faded.
ex.zh: 天色暗下来之前，她快速画了一幅海港速写。

ex.en: The article sketches the history of the labor movement in broad outline.
ex.zh: 这篇文章粗略概述了工人运动的历史。

ex.en: The resort attracts thousands of tourists every winter, most of whom come to ski on its well-groomed slopes.
ex.zh: 该度假胜地每年冬天吸引成千上万的游客，其中大多数人前来在修剪良好的雪坡上滑雪。

ex.en: Winter tourism in the Alps depends on reliable snow, and several poor seasons have already hurt skiing businesses.
ex.zh: 阿尔卑斯山的冬季旅游依赖稳定的降雪，连续几个歉雪的年份已使滑雪业受损。

senses: adj. (in, at)灵巧的,娴熟的,熟练的

ex.en: A skilful negotiator knows when to press an advantage and when to offer a compromise.
ex.zh: 娴熟的谈判者知道何时施加优势，何时作出让步。

senses: n. 技巧,技艺;技术,技能

ex.en: Employers increasingly value communication skills as much as technical expertise when recruiting new graduates.
ex.zh: 招聘应届毕业生时，雇主们越来越把沟通技能看得与技术专长同样重要。

ex.en: The factory's biggest challenge is the shortage of skilled workers able to operate advanced equipment.
ex.zh: 这家工厂最大的挑战是缺少能够操作先进设备的熟练工人。

ex.en: A skillful translator preserves not only the meaning of a text but also its tone and rhythm.
ex.zh: 高明的译者不仅保留原文的意思，还保留其语气与节奏。

senses: vt. 掠过或擦过(某物的表面)

ex.en: I skimmed the list until I found my name.
ex.zh: 我浏览了一下名单，直到找到我的名字。

ex.en: I skimmed the report quickly before the meeting.
ex.zh: 开会前我快速浏览了一下报告。

ex.en: Skim the fat from the surface of the soup before serving.
ex.zh: 上桌前撇去汤表面的浮油。

senses: n. 皮肤；毛皮；外皮；肠衣

ex.en: Dermatologists advise people to avoid direct exposure to strong sunlight, which can damage the skin permanently.
ex.zh: 皮肤科医生建议人们避免直接暴露在强烈阳光下，因为阳光会对皮肤造成永久性伤害。

senses: adj. 身无分文的,穷光蛋的

ex.en: After paying the deposit, he was completely skint and had to borrow money from his flatmate.
ex.zh: 付完押金后，他身无分文，只得向室友借钱。

senses: v. 跳,蹦;很快地改变(话题、职业等)

ex.en: Nutritionists warn that students who regularly skip breakfast find it harder to concentrate in morning classes.
ex.zh: 营养学家警告，经常不吃早餐的学生在上午的课堂上更难集中注意力。

senses: v. 当……的队长(或船长、机长)

ex.en: The experienced skipper refused to leave harbour until the storm warning was officially lifted.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的船长在风暴警报正式解除之前拒绝出港。

ex.en: The village skirts the northern edge of the lake, offering travelers splendid views along the winding road.
ex.zh: 村庄沿湖的北缘延伸，蜿蜒的道路为旅行者提供了壮丽的景色。

ex.en: Archaeologists unearthed a skull estimated to be more than five thousand years old at the burial site.
ex.zh: 考古学家在墓地出土了一具据估计有五千多年历史的头骨。

ex.en: On clear nights, the sky above the desert offers a spectacular view of countless stars.
ex.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，沙漠上空的天空呈现出无数星星的壮丽景象。

ex.en: The studio's large skylight floods the room with natural light, so the artists rarely need lamps.
ex.zh: 画室的大天窗让室内充满自然光，艺术家们几乎不需要灯具。

ex.en: Housing prices skyrocketed after the new railway line was announced, pricing out many local families.
ex.zh: 新铁路线公布后房价飞涨，许多当地家庭因此无力购房。

ex.en: The city's newest skyscraper was designed to use a third less energy than conventional office towers.
ex.zh: 该市最新的摩天大楼在设计上能耗比传统写字楼低三分之一。

senses: adj. ①不紧的，不严的，松弛的
②松懈的，疏忽的；③(生意)萧条的，不景气的
n. ①淡季，萧条；②(pl.) 便裤，宽松长裤
adj. 懈怠的，松弛的；萧条的
adj. 懈怠的；不紧的；萧条的
slack.usage: 反义 tight adj. 紧的，拉紧的，绷紧的；adj.松散的，松弛的；懈怠的；索引p416

ex.en: She has been very slack in her study lately.
ex.zh: 她最近学习很松懈。

ex.en: Security at the plant has grown slack in recent months.
ex.zh: 近几个月来，工厂的安保变得松懈。

ex.en: Business is slack during the winter months.
ex.zh: 冬季几个月生意清淡。

slacken.usage: vi.松劲，懈怠；变松弛 vt.使缓慢；使松弛

ex.en: Economists expect demand to slacken as rising interest rates discourage borrowing.
ex.zh: 经济学家预计，随着利率上升抑制借贷，需求将会放缓。

senses: vt. 砰地关上,砰地放下,猛力挟击,冲击

ex.en: She was so angry that she slammed the door and left without saying a word.
ex.zh: 她气得砰地关上门，一句话也没说就走了。

ex.en: The magazine agreed to pay damages after publishing comments that the court ruled were slander.
ex.zh: 该杂志发表的言论被法院认定为诽谤，随后同意支付赔偿金。

ex.en: The dictionary now includes internet slang, reflecting how quickly informal language enters everyday use.
ex.zh: 该词典现在收录了网络俚语，反映出非正式语言进入日常用语的迅速程度。

ex.en: He slapped the table in frustration, drawing every diner's attention in the quiet restaurant.
ex.zh: 他懊恼地一拍桌子，引来安静餐厅里所有食客的注意。

senses: v./n. 屠宰,残杀;彻底击败

ex.en: The documentary reveals how the illegal slaughter of elephants has driven the species close to extinction.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片揭示了非法屠杀大象如何使该物种濒临灭绝。

senses: n. [C] 奴隶；完全受（某事物）控制的人

ex.en: Millions of slaves were transported across the Atlantic in the eighteenth century.
ex.zh: 十八世纪，数百万奴隶被运过大西洋。

ex.en: She refused to be a slave to fashion.
ex.zh: 她拒绝做时尚的奴隶。

ex.en: The novel describes the life of a slave on a southern plantation.
ex.zh: 这部小说描写了南方种植园上一名奴隶的生活。

ex.en: More significantly, they argue that many of the Founding Fathers knew slavery was wrong—and yet most did little to fight it.
ex.zh: 更加值得注意的是，他们认为许多开国元勋明知奴隶制是错误的，却很少有人试图去推翻它。

ex.en: Studies show that adults who sleep fewer than six hours a night tend to perform worse on memory tests.
ex.zh: 研究表明，每晚睡眠不足六小时的成年人在记忆测试中往往表现较差。

phrases.m: 卷起袖子(准备工作或战斗)

ex.en: The mechanic rolled up each sleeve before starting work on the engine.
ex.zh: 机修工在开始检修发动机前卷起了袖子。

senses: adj. 苗条的,修长的,细长的

ex.en: The bridge is supported by slender steel cables that nonetheless carry enormous weight.
ex.zh: 这座桥由纤细的钢缆支撑，尽管纤细却能承受巨大的重量。

ex.en: He cut a thin slice of bread and shared it with his younger brother.
ex.zh: 他切下一薄片面包，与弟弟分享。

senses: v. 悄悄地走,徐徐而行
n. 滑行,滑动,滑落;滑道,滑梯;幻灯片

ex.en: House prices began to slide in the second quarter, raising concerns about the health of the economy.
ex.zh: 房价在第二季度开始下滑，引发了对经济健康状况的担忧。

senses: adj. 轻微的，略微的；细小的
slight.usage: s(发音似"丝")+light(轻的)→像蚕丝一样又轻又细→轻微的，细小的

ex.en: This gives rats the ability to detect slight smells.
ex.zh: 这使老鼠能够察觉轻微的气味。

ex.en: Doctors noted a slight improvement in the patient's condition.
ex.zh: 医生注意到病人的病情略有好转。

ex.en: The difference between the two groups was too slight to be significant.
ex.zh: 两组之间的差异太细微，不具显著性。

slightly.usage: adv.稍微，轻微地；slight 的派生词

ex.en: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
ex.zh: 本案中用隐私法限制科技巨头似乎稍显牵强。

senses: a. 苗条的；单薄的；不足的
v. (用运动、节食等)减轻体重使体形苗条

ex.en: There is only a slim chance that the lost painting will be recovered, the police admitted.
ex.zh: 警方承认，失窃画作被找回的希望渺茫。

senses: n. [C] (悬吊受伤手臂的)悬带；(用以背婴儿的)吊兜；投石器(旧时武器)
vt. (随便地)扔，丢；遣送；押往；撵走；驱逐
n. 吊索;吊腕带;投石器

ex.en: He slung his bag over his shoulder and rushed to the station, afraid of missing the last train.
ex.zh: 他把包往肩上一甩，急忙赶往车站，生怕错过末班火车。

slip.usage: 助记:slip(滑倒)把lip(嘴唇)摔破了;n.疏漏,差错(a slip of the pen笔误)；国外公共场所“小心地面湿滑”图片→滑（倒）。

ex.en: As I ran up the stairs, my foot slipped and I fell.
ex.zh: 我跑上楼梯时，失脚摔倒了。

ex.en: She wrote the address on a slip of paper and handed it to me.
ex.zh: 她把地址写在一张纸条上递给我。

ex.en: Careless slips in the data can undermine the whole study.
ex.zh: 数据中的粗心失误可能损害整项研究。

ex.en: After a long day at work, he changed into comfortable slippers as soon as he got home.
ex.zh: 结束一天的工作后，他一到家就换上了舒适的拖鞋。

senses: a. 滑的；油滑的；棘手的
adj. (对问题等)要小心对待的
adj. 滑的，光滑的；油滑的

ex.en: The road is slippery after a heavy storm.
ex.zh: 大雨后路很滑。

ex.en: Wet leaves make the stone steps especially slippery in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天，湿树叶使石阶特别湿滑。

ex.en: The concept of fairness is slippery and hard to define precisely.
ex.zh: “公平”这个概念难以捉摸，很难精确定义。

ex.en: A small slipup in the accounts led auditors to examine the company's records for the past five years.
ex.zh: 账目中的一个小疏漏促使审计人员审查了该公司过去五年的账簿。

ex.en: He slit the envelope open carefully, hoping to reuse it later.
ex.zh: 他小心地裁开信封，希望以后还能重复使用。

ex.en: The company's new advertising slogan quickly caught on, appearing on billboards across the country.
ex.zh: 公司的新广告口号迅速流行起来，出现在全国各地的广告牌上。

ex.en: The path slopes gently upward for about two miles before reaching the observation deck.
ex.zh: 这条小路平缓上坡约两英里后到达观景台。

senses: n. 缝;投币口;(表格)空位;(计)插槽

ex.en: Applicants must submit their forms before Friday to secure an interview slot next week.
ex.zh: 申请者必须在周五之前提交表格，以确保获得下周的面试名额。

ex.en: Medieval writers listed sloth among the deadly sins, warning that idleness wastes both talent and time.
ex.zh: 中世纪作家把懒惰列为七宗罪之一，警告说游手好闲既浪费才华又浪费时间。

ex.en: Economic growth slowed noticeably in the final quarter, prompting the government to announce new stimulus measures.
ex.zh: 经济增长在最后一个季度明显放缓，促使政府宣布新的刺激措施。

slowdown.usage: n.减速；怠工；降低速度；索引p417

ex.en: The global economic slowdown has hurt export industries across Asia.
ex.zh: 全球经济放缓使亚洲各地的出口产业受到冲击。

ex.en: Factory output fell sharply because of a slowdown in consumer spending.
ex.zh: 由于消费支出放缓，工厂产出大幅下降。

ex.en: The union denied that the workers were organizing a slowdown.
ex.zh: 工会否认工人们在组织怠工。

senses: n. 烂泥,淤泥;工业废物

ex.en: The factory was fined for pumping toxic sludge into the river at night.
ex.zh: 该工厂因夜间向河里排放有毒污泥而被罚款。

senses: adj. 行动迟缓的；无精打采的；迟钝的
adj. 行动缓慢的,迟缓的;懒散的

ex.en: Trading on the stock market was sluggish this morning as investors waited for the latest inflation figures.
ex.zh: 今早股市交易清淡，投资者在等待最新的通胀数据。

ex.en: The government has launched a program to improve housing and sanitation in the city's crowded slums.
ex.zh: 政府已启动一项计划，改善该市拥挤贫民窟的住房与卫生条件。

senses: vi. 骤降，猛跌，锐减；重重地坐下（或倒下）
v. (价格、价值、数量等)骤降,猛跌,锐减
v. 重重地坐下(或倒下)
n. 骤降,猛跌;萧条期,衰退
n. 衰退，萧条期；（销售量、价格等）骤降
v.（价格、价值、数量等）骤降，锐减
slump.usage: 同义drop,decline;助记:slum(贫民窟)的数量slump(锐减)；s+lump（肿块）→有肿块，说明健康在“衰退”；索引p417

ex.en: Most of us have survived a recession, so we're familiar with the belt-tightening strategies needed to survive a slump.
ex.zh: 我们大多数人都有从经济衰退中挺过来的经历，所以熟悉在衰退中生存所需的紧缩策略。

ex.en: House prices slumped by fifteen percent within a year.
ex.zh: 一年之内房价暴跌了百分之十五。

ex.en: The country's economy slid into a deep slump.
ex.zh: 该国经济陷入严重衰退。

sly.usage: 同义shrewd,cunning,tricky;反义frank adj.坦白的,直率的

ex.en: The sly fox in the fable always manages to escape by flattering the other animals.
ex.zh: 寓言中狡猾的狐狸总能靠奉承其他动物而逃脱。

ex.en: Even small changes in temperature can affect the growth rate of these rare plants.
ex.zh: 即使是微小的温度变化也会影响这些珍稀植物的生长速度。

senses: a. 衣着讲究的；光鲜的；聪明的；智能的
adj. ①聪明的，伶俐的 ②有力的，猛烈的
③帅气的，整齐的，漂亮的，时髦的

ex.en: Smart devices are being installed in homes to cut energy waste and reduce household bills.
ex.zh: 智能设备正被安装到家庭中，以减少能源浪费和家庭开支。

ex.en: The average smartphone now contains more computing power than the machines that guided the first moon landing.
ex.zh: 如今一部普通智能手机的运算能力超过了引导首次登月的计算机。

ex.en: The thieves smashed the shop window and stole the jewelry.
ex.zh: 窃贼砸碎商店橱窗，偷走了珠宝。

ex.en: The car smashed into a tree, but no one was seriously hurt.
ex.zh: 汽车猛撞到树上，但没有人受重伤。

ex.en: The crisis smashed the government's plans for tax cuts.
ex.zh: 这场危机粉碎了政府的减税计划。

senses: v. (smelled/smelt) ①嗅，闻到 ②有某种气味

ex.en: The sharp smell of paint filled the office, so the staff opened all the windows.
ex.zh: 办公室里弥漫着刺鼻的油漆味，于是员工们打开了所有的窗户。

senses: vt. 微笑着说；现出（某种）笑容

ex.en: The waiter greeted every customer with a warm smile, which made the small restaurant popular.
ex.zh: 服务员用温暖的微笑迎接每一位顾客，这使这家小餐馆大受欢迎。

ex.en: Heavy smog covered the city for a week, forcing schools to cancel outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 浓烟雾笼罩城市一周，迫使学校取消了户外活动。

senses: n. [U] 烟；[C-常用sing.] 吸烟；抽烟

ex.en: Doctors warn that breathing secondhand smoke can be as harmful to children as smoking itself.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，吸入二手烟对儿童的危害可能与吸烟本身一样大。

ex.en: Doctors found that a former smoker's risk of heart disease falls significantly within five years of quitting.
ex.zh: 医生发现，戒烟后五年内，曾吸烟者患心脏病的风险会显著下降。

senses: adj. 平滑的,光滑的;平稳的,平静的
adj. 流畅的;平和的,安详的
v. 弄平,使平滑;铺平(道路);缓和,减轻

ex.en: The transition to the new system was remarkably smooth, with hardly any complaints from users.
ex.zh: 向新系统的过渡异常顺利，几乎没有收到用户的抱怨。

smuggle.usage: 派生smuggler n.偷偷入境者;走私者;smuggling n.走私,偷运,私运

ex.en: Customs officers arrested two men who attempted to smuggle rare animals across the border last night.
ex.zh: 海关人员昨晚逮捕了两名企图走私珍稀动物过境的男子。

senses: n. 点心,小吃,快餐;易办到的事

ex.en: Nutritionists suggest replacing sugary snacks with fruit to keep energy levels stable during the day.
ex.zh: 营养学家建议用水果代替含糖零食，以保持白天精力稳定。

ex.en: The hiker froze when he spotted a snake coiled on the path directly ahead of him.
ex.zh: 远足者发现一条蛇盘在正前方的路上时僵住了。

senses: n. 猛咬;突然折断;劈啪声
v. 猛咬;抓住;谩骂;突然折断;使劈啪地响

ex.en: To reverse the negative influences of snap decisions, we should think before we act.
ex.zh: 为了扭转匆忙决策所造成的负面影响，我们应该三思而后行。

ex.en: The branch snapped under the weight of the snow.
ex.zh: 树枝在积雪的重压下啪地折断了。

ex.en: She snapped a few photographs of the old temple before it was demolished.
ex.zh: 老庙被拆除之前，她抢拍了几张照片。

senses: n. 照片,快照;简介;简要情况

ex.en: The survey offers a snapshot of public opinion on the day before the election was announced.
ex.zh: 这项调查提供了选举消息公布前一天公众舆论的简要写照。

senses: v. 夺得,一把抓住;抓机会做,抽空做
v. 抢走，夺去；抓紧时间做；一下夺过
snatch.usage: 辨析:seize突然抓住;snatch抢走,更快或暴力;grab较正式,粗野快;capture俘虏

ex.en: I managed to snatch an hour's sleep.
ex.zh: 我偷空儿睡了一小时的觉。

ex.en: A thief snatched her bag and ran off down the street.
ex.zh: 一个小偷抢走她的手提包，沿街跑掉了。

ex.en: The team snatched victory in the final seconds of the match.
ex.zh: 该队在比赛最后几秒钟夺得胜利。

senses: v. 偷偷地走,潜行;[口]偷窃
n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人;偷偷摸摸的行为
adj. 不声不响进行的;偷偷的

ex.en: Reporters managed to sneak into the building before the security guards arrived to lock the gates.
ex.zh: 记者们赶在保安到场锁门之前设法溜进了大楼。

ex.en: Sales of the new sneaker doubled after a famous athlete was seen wearing it.
ex.zh: 一位著名运动员被拍到穿着这款新运动鞋后，其销量翻了一番。

phrases.m: 值得考虑的,不可轻视的

ex.en: The allergy made her sneeze repeatedly throughout the spring, forcing her to stay indoors.
ex.zh: 过敏使她整个春天不停地打喷嚏，只好待在室内。

ex.en: The dog sniffed the suitcase carefully before the officers allowed it onto the train.
ex.zh: 狗仔细嗅过那只行李箱后，工作人员才允许它被带上火车。

senses: adj. 势利的;自命不凡的

ex.en: Critics called the new club snobbish because it admitted only members with university degrees.
ex.zh: 批评者称这家新俱乐部很势利，因为它只接纳拥有大学学位的会员。

ex.en: Heavy snow blocked the mountain roads, leaving hundreds of travelers stranded at the small station overnight.
ex.zh: 大雪封住了山路，数百名旅客被困在小车站过夜。

ex.en: The forecasters' snowstorm warning came too late for the hundreds of drivers already on the motorway.
ex.zh: 对已在高速公路上的数百名司机而言，暴风雪预警来得太晚了。

ex.en: The snowy peaks attract climbers every summer, despite the obvious risks of altitude and cold.
ex.zh: 尽管明显存在高海拔和严寒的风险，积雪的山峰每年夏天仍吸引登山者前来。

senses: ad. 这么，这样，那么，那样，如此；很

ex.en: The evidence was so convincing that even the harshest critics had to accept the theory.
ex.zh: 证据如此令人信服，以至于最严厉的批评者也不得不接受这一理论。

ex.en: Many so-called miracle diets fail because they ignore basic principles of nutrition.
ex.zh: 许多所谓的神奇饮食法之所以失败，是因为它们无视基本的营养学原理。

soak.usage: 反义 dry v. 晾干

ex.en: Soak the dried mushrooms in warm water for twenty minutes before adding them to the soup.
ex.zh: 把干蘑菇在温水中浸泡二十分钟，然后再加进汤里。

ex.en: The company developed a soap that is gentle on the skin and made entirely from plant oils.
ex.zh: 该公司研制出一款对皮肤温和、完全由植物油制成的肥皂。

senses: n. 高飞范围；高涨程度；高飞，飞升
vi. 急剧增加，飙升；高飞

ex.en: Net-zero rules set to send cost of new homes and extensions soaring.
ex.zh: 净零排放规定的出台将使新房和扩建成本飙升。

ex.en: House prices soared after the new subway line was announced.
ex.zh: 新地铁线路公布后，房价飙升。

ex.en: The number of students applying for the course has soared this year.
ex.zh: 今年申请该课程的学生人数猛增。

sob.usage: 助记:演出失败的son(儿子)在sob(哭泣)

ex.en: She began to sob quietly when the judge announced that custody had been granted to her.
ex.zh: 当法官宣布监护权判归她时，她开始低声抽泣。

senses: adj. 冷静的,清醒的;认真的,审慎的
sober.usage: 联想记忆: sob(哭泣)+er(人)→哭完人就清醒了→使清醒；索引p417

ex.en: The sobering aspect of Allen's book is that we have no one else to blame for our present condition except ourselves.
ex.zh: 艾伦的书令人警醒的一面在于：对于我们目前的处境，除了我们自己，没有任何人可以归咎。

ex.en: Soccer has grown into the world's most popular sport, with billions of fans across every continent.
ex.zh: 足球已发展成为世界上最受欢迎的运动，各大洲拥有数十亿球迷。

ex.en: From the root soci, meaning to associate or join, come such familiar words as social, society and associate.
ex.zh: 意为“联合、结交”的词根 soci 衍生出 social、society 和 associate 等常见词。

senses: adj. 好交际的，友善的，合群的
adj. 好交际的；友好的，合群的
sociable.usage: 反义 unsociable；派生 sociability n. 友好，和善；索引p417

ex.en: The girl is sociable and has many friends in this city.
ex.zh: 这个女孩很好交际，在这个城市有很多朋友。

ex.en: Sociable employees tend to build wider networks at work.
ex.zh: 好交际的员工往往在工作中建立起更广的人脉。

ex.en: My grandmother was a warm, sociable woman who loved company.
ex.zh: 我的祖母是一位热情好客、爱交际的女士。

senses: adj. 社会的；社交的；群居的
social.usage: 派生 socially adv. 在社会上；在社交方面；adj.社会的；社交的；索引p417

ex.en: Social media allows users to experience news events more intimately and immediately while also permitting them to re-share news as a projection of their values and interests.
ex.zh: 社交媒体允许用户转发新闻报道来表达自己的价值观和兴趣的同时，也使用户更为密切及时地关注把握时事动态。

ex.en: She has a busy social life.
ex.zh: 她的社交活动很频繁。

ex.en: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
ex.zh: 这些社会援助项目被称作有条件的现金转移支付或 CCT，旨在减少不平等和打破贫困的恶性循环。

ex.en: The student culture becomes the chief socialising force for new postgraduate students.
ex.zh: 学生文化成为新入学研究生的主要社交推动力。

ex.en: Teachers encourage new students to socialise with classmates from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 老师们鼓励新生与来自不同文化背景的同学交往。

ex.en: The party's early programme combined socialism with demands for land reform and universal education.
ex.zh: 该党早期的纲领把社会主义与土地改革和普及教育的要求结合在一起。

ex.en: Sociologists argue that early socialization within the family shapes a child's later political attitudes.
ex.zh: 社会学家认为，家庭中的早期社会化塑造了孩子日后的政治态度。

senses: ad. 在社会上；在社交上

ex.en: Children who grow up in large families tend to be more socially confident, the survey suggests.
ex.zh: 调查显示，在大家庭中长大的孩子往往在社交上更自信。

senses: n. 社会；社团，协会，学会

ex.en: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
ex.zh: 英国的新规提醒银行家们：社会与他们的表现利害攸关，不仅仅是在短期内，长远看来更是如此。

ex.en: Modern society depends heavily on the smooth flow of digital information.
ex.zh: 现代社会高度依赖数字信息的顺畅流动。

ex.en: She joined the university's debating society in her first year.
ex.zh: 她一年级就加入了大学的辩论社团。

ex.en: One sociologist argues that online communities have changed how young people define friendship.
ex.zh: 一位社会学家认为，网络社区改变了年轻人定义友谊的方式。

sociology.usage: 派生 sociological adj. 社会学的；sociologist n. 社会学家；n.社会学

ex.en: She took a course in sociology to understand urban poverty.
ex.zh: 她修了一门社会学课程，以了解城市贫困问题。

ex.en: Sociology examines how institutions shape human behaviour.
ex.zh: 社会学研究制度如何塑造人类行为。

ex.en: He switched from law to sociology in his second year.
ex.zh: 他在二年级时从法律专业转到了社会学专业。

ex.en: The charity collects warm clothes and socks for homeless people during the cold winter months.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构在寒冷的冬季为无家可归者收集保暖衣物和袜子。

ex.en: Always switch off the power at the socket before attempting to repair any electrical appliance.
ex.zh: 检修任何电器之前，务必先在插座处切断电源。

ex.en: Nutritionists have linked the daily consumption of soda to rising levels of childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 营养学家认为，每天饮用汽水与儿童肥胖率上升有关。

ex.en: He fell asleep on the sofa again, with the television still on and a book open on his lap.
ex.zh: 他又在沙发上睡着了，电视还开着，腿上摊着一本书。

senses: a. 软的；较软的；柔滑的；柔和的；轻柔的
adj. 软的;温柔的;细嫩的;光滑的;不含酒精的

ex.en: The new policy has been criticized for being too soft on companies that repeatedly break safety rules.
ex.zh: 新政策因对屡次违反安全规定的公司过于宽松而受到批评。

ex.en: The government later softened its position, allowing limited imports of the banned product.
ex.zh: 政府后来缓和了立场，允许有限度地进口该禁售产品。

ex.en: The shampoo contains a natural softener that leaves hair smooth without synthetic additives.
ex.zh: 这款洗发水含有天然软化剂，无需合成添加剂就能让头发顺滑。
